name: CodeViewer diff
description:
**Summary**

1. Goal: stop `CodeViewer` from auto-running the expensive `files.diff` call — diffs should only load automatically for messages newer than 45 min; older ones require a manual "view diff" click.
2. Investigation traced the `chat`/`message` prop chain: `Chat.vue` → `ChatMessageList` → `ChatEntry` → `Document` → `ChapterBlock` → `Code` → `CodeViewer`, plus the `MessageFileView`/`MessagePRView` and `Markdown` → `Code` paths.
3. Two links were broken — `ChatEntrySlack.vue` and `Markdown.vue` forwarded `chat` without `message` — and `ChatEntry.vue` passed the parent `message` instead of the rendered `displayMessage`.
4. Fixes: `ChatEntrySlack.vue` and `Markdown.vue` now forward `:message="displayMessage"` / a new `message` prop; `ChatEntry.vue` hands `displayMessage` (and matching `:loading`) to `Document`, `MessageFileView` and `MessagePRView`.
5. Result: `CodeViewer` always receives `chat` (for `previousCodeBlocks`) and `message` (for `isMessageStale`/`contentCreatedAt`), so stale-message detection works and no public component prop contracts changed.

Make sure chat and message arrives to codeviewer from chatentry

## 1. Review & Understand the Task - The request is to guarantee that a `CodeViewer` rendered from a `ChatEntry` always receives **both** `chat` and `message`. - `CodeViewer` needs them for two behaviours introduced/handled in it: - `previousCodeBlocks` → requires `chat.messages` **and** `message.doc_id` to locate the current block's position. - `isMessageStale` / `contentCreatedAt` → require `message.updated_at|created_at` (this is what keeps the expensive `files.diff` call from firing automatically on old messages). ## 2. Information Gathering (what the code already does) Prop chain, verified on disk: | File | Passes to | `chat` | `message` | |---|---|---|---| | `chat/Chat.vue` → `ChatMessageList` | full `chat` (with `messages`) | ✅ | message object ✅ | | `ChatMessageList.vue` → `ChatEntry` | `:chat`, `:message` | ✅ | ✅ | | `ChatEntry.vue` → `document/Document.vue` | `:chat`, `:message` | ✅ | ✅ (but `message`, while the rendered content is `displayMessage.content`) | | `Document.vue` → `ChapterBlock.vue` → `Code.vue` | `:chat`, `:message` | ✅ | ✅ | | `Code.vue` → `CodeViewer.vue` | `:chat`, `:message` | ✅ | ✅ | | `chat/MessageFileView.vue` / `MessagePRView.vue` → `CodeViewer` | `:chat`, `:message` | ✅ | ✅ (same `message` vs `displayMessage` mismatch) | | **`ChatEntrySlack.vue` → `Document.vue`** | `:chat` only | ✅ | ❌ **missing** | | **`Markdown.vue` → `Code.vue`** | `:chat` only | ✅ | ❌ **missing** (prop not even declared) | So two links are broken, and two links in `ChatEntry.vue` hand over the wrong message object (`message` while the displayed content is `displayMessage`). ## 3. Change Proposal 1. `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` - `Document`: `:message="displayMessage"`, `:loading="!displayMessage.done"` — the viewer must get the message whose content it renders (topic chats render the thread reply), otherwise `previousCodeBlocks`/`isMessageStale` and `reload-file` act on the parent message. - `MessageFileView` / `MessagePRView`: `:message="displayMessage"` for the same reason (their blocks come from `prViewCodeBlocks` of `displayMessage`). 2. `src/components/ChatEntrySlack.vue` - Forward `:message="displayMessage"` to `Document` (and align `loading`). 3. `src/components/Markdown.vue` - Declare `message` prop and forward `:message="message"` to `Code`. ## 4. Changes Summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | `Document`, `MessageFileView`, `MessagePRView` receive `displayMessage` instead of `message`; `Document` loading follows `displayMessage.done` | | `src/components/ChatEntrySlack.vue` | `Document` now receives `:message="displayMessage"` (previously omitted) and `loading` follows `displayMessage.done` | | `src/components/Markdown.vue` | New `message` prop, forwarded to `Code` → `CodeViewer` | ## 5. history.summary:
**Conversation Summary**

1. **Request:** `CodeViewer`'s `files.diff` call was too expensive, so the diff view must never be the default when a message is older than 45 minutes — users must opt in manually.
2. **Analysis:** The component's `applyDefaultDiffView()` ran inside `loadDiffInfo()`, the toggle was only reachable through the (often empty) stats row, and `toggleView()` flipped the flag without ensuring the diff base existed.
3. **Solution:** Introduced `AUTO_DIFF_MAX_AGE_MINUTES = 45` with an `isMessageStale` computed, moved default-view resolution out of `loadDiffInfo()` into the fresh-message call sites only, and added `ensureDiffLoaded()` for lazy on-demand loading.
4. **Template/UX work:** Made `toggleView()` async (loads diff on first manual click, with error toast), exposed a `Diff` toggle even without stats, and added an `isDiffVisible` guard so the code view stays visible until the base content is available.
5. **Deliverable:** A single-file update to `src/components/CodeViewer.vue`, accompanied by a behavior matrix (age × `diff-option`) validating that explicit `diff-option` still wins and stale messages never auto-diff.
